entities.summary:
Erasinides was a skilled Athenian general and commander of the Athenian fleet, appointed to lead the naval campaign against the Spartans after the Battle of Notium in 407 BCE.



He played a crucial role in the Athenian victory at the Battle of Aegospotami in 405 BCE, where he clashed with the Spartan admiral Lysander. However, the Athenian fleet was defeated, and Erasinides was killed in action.



Despite his tragic end, Erasinides' legacy as a brilliant tactician and naval commander has endured for centuries, influencing the development of Greek naval warfare and inspiring later naval leaders.
